note: Pathogenic NAV3 variants impair microtubule stabilization in vitro, supporting mechanistic investigation of domain-specific missense clustering.

evidence.text: Variants in NAV3—including de novo, heterozygous, and biallelic alterations—cause a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by intellectual disability, microcephaly, and behavioral issues, and pathogenic variants impaired NAV3's ability to stabilize microtubules in cellular assays.

source.title: Variants of NAV3, a neuronal morphogenesis protein, cause intellectual disability, developmental delay, and microcephaly
source.quote: When overexpressed in HEK293T and COS7 cells, pathogenic variants impaired NAV3 ability to stabilize microtubules.

evidence.text: A homozygous missense variant (p.Ser1144Pro) within a highly conserved and functionally critical domain of NAV3 causes autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder, confirming that pathogenic missense changes affect conserved functional regions.

source.title: NAV3 Missense Variant in a Homozygous State: Strengthening Links to Neurodevelopmental Disorder
